summary: Converts GeoJSON into a vector data cube
description: Converts GeoJSON data as defined by [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946.html) into a vector data cube. Feature properties are preserved. The properties given in the parameter `properties` also become the values of the data cube.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A GeoJSON object to convert into a vector data cube. The GeoJSON type `GeometryCollection` is not supported. Each geometry in the GeoJSON data results in a dimension label in the `geometry` dimension.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description:
The feature properties to use as the values of the data cube. Only applies for GeoJSON Features and FeatureCollections. The names refer to the members of the feature properties, not to the top-level `id` of the features.

- `null` (default): No values are loaded. A dimension `properties` of type `other` is created with a single dimension label `value` and no-data values.
- List of property names: A dimension `properties` of type `other` is created with the property names as dimension labels. The values of the properties are expected to be scalars.
- Single property name: A dimension `properties` of type `other` is created. The values of the property are expected to be arrays and the dimension labels are the array indices. There are as many labels as the longest array has elements.

Missing values and values that don't have the expected structure (e.g. an array in a list of properties) are set to the no-data value.

Although mixing data types of values is generally allowed, certain combinations of data types may be unsupported by some implementations. It is recommended to keep the data types homogeneous.

returns.description: A vector data cube with the dimensions `geometry` and `properties`.
